name: Port Royal
text: Port Royal is a town on Port Royal Island in Beaufort County, South Carolina, United States. The population was 14,220 at the 2020 census. It is part of the Hilton Head Island metropolitan area.

depictions.name: Port Royal
depictions.text: Port Royal is a small town located on the far side of Kingston's harbor, opposite to the city itself. Prior to the earthquake of 1692, the town was host to a number of British forts, including Fort Charles, which was the only one to survive the earthquake. The town proved to be a particular refuge for privateers and pirates during the early 18th century, before the founding of the Pirate Republic in Nassau, where they acted as a welcome deterrent against Spanish attacks.
